subject: RStan multiple parallel instances run in the same directory gives unserialize error

messages.author: f13fe7e880ed6103
messages.subject: RStan multiple parallel instances run in the same directory gives unserialize error
parts:
Hi. I've got an R script that calls:

library(rstan) # version 2.9.0-3
rstan_options(auto_write = T)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
m <- stan_model(file='model.stan')
fit = sampling(m,data,chains=4)

I start up a couple instances in parallel in the same directory using Rscript:

$ Rscript  myscript.r param1 param2 &
$ Rscript  myscript.r param1 param3 &

And sometimes I see the following error from one of the programs after some (but usually not all) of the chains have completed:

Error in unserialize(node$con) : error reading from connection
Calls: sampling ... FUN -> recvData -> recvData.SOCK0node -> unserialize
Execution halted

Any idea what's going on? Could it have to do with the auto_write = T option and / or something related to the fact that when I start two scripts in parallel they both compile the Stan model simultaneously? Or is this a quirk of my environment--shared server with file system on NFS; I should probably switch to local storage in any case.

Note that I can't reliably reproduce this at the moment (but let me give that another try if no one has ideas...)

Seth
